versions.changelog:
Initial release: Monetize and monitor your OpenClaw agent via API endpoints.

- Returns agent status (active/idle) and cron job health.
- Provides platform uptime information.
- Includes endpoints for geocoding (via Nominatim) and weather data (via Open-Meteo).
- API endpoints require $0.001 USDC payment per request via x402 on Base.
- Easy setup for Vercel or local deployment.
- Example responses included for quick integration.
